topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Genetic and Epigenetic Tumor Drivers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive Darwinian clonal expansion in tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties influence which cells initiate and propagate tumors.

topics.label: Tumor Microenvironment, Inflammatory Signaling, and Cancer Evolution Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how permissive microenvironments and inflammatory cues interact with tumor cells to enable malignant progression, concluding with an integrated synthesis of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer ends the presentation and previews the topic of the following lecture.
